sources.title: Department of Immigration and Emigration (Sri Lanka), Business Visa
sources.said: A Business Purpose Visa is issued to foreign nationals who visit Sri Lanka for business purposes for short period of time. This visa may be issued for single or multiple journeys. Allowed activities: … Participate in art, music and dance events … Not allowed activities: Engage in Business/Trade activities, Engage in employment paid/unpaid, self –employment … Required Documents: Invitation/ Request letter from relevant institutions

sources.title: Department of Immigration and Emigration, ETA: How to apply (eta.gov.lk)
sources.said: Sri Lanka Overseas Mission, with the concurrence of the Department of Immigration & Emigration (DI&E), will issue ETA or short stay visa within 03 business days. … Business ETA can be obtained only from; … Sri Lanka Overseas Missions are authorized to issue ETA for up to 30 days and Short Visit visas (Tourist Visa with single or double entry and Business Purposes ETA with single, double or multiple entries) for up to 03 months.

note: The Business Purpose Visa admits taking part in art, music and dance events but not paid or unpaid employment; a performer employed by a Sri Lankan employer would need a residence visa in the employment category, which isn't modelled apart. Film shoots' own approvals weren't researched as a permit.
